_comment: Structured version of docs/taxonomy.md. This file IS the specification for the deterministic flag-matching engine (see architecture.md §6). Do not let the LLM re-derive these rules at runtime — it only fills the templates with extracted values. Edit taxonomy.md and this file together; they must never drift apart.

redFlags.name: Room rent capping
redFlags.template: Your room rent is capped at {cap_value}. If you choose a room above this, the insurer proportionately reduces your ENTIRE claim, not just the room charge — this can cut a large claim significantly.

redFlags.name: Disease-specific sub-limit
redFlags.triggerCondition: sub_limits[] contains an entry where sub_limit_value < sum_insured
redFlags.template: Your policy advertises {sum_insured} cover, but {procedure} is capped at {sub_limit_value}. You would pay the difference out of pocket.

redFlags.name: Co-payment clause
redFlags.template: You pay {co_pay_pct}% of every approved claim yourself. On a ₹2,00,000 claim, that's ₹{calculated_amount} from your pocket.

redFlags.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period
redFlags.template: Conditions you already have won't be covered for {waiting_period} from policy start. A claim related to {condition} during this period will be rejected.

redFlags.name: Initial waiting period
redFlags.triggerCondition: initial_waiting_period_days >= 30 (standard clause, always check for presence)
redFlags.template: Almost no claim (except accidental injury) is payable in the first 30 days of this policy.

redFlags.name: Specific disease/procedure waiting period
redFlags.triggerCondition: named_procedure_waiting_periods[] contains an entry with waiting_period_months in [12,24]
redFlags.template: {procedure} isn't covered until {waiting_period} into the policy, even though it's not a pre-existing condition.

redFlags.name: Material non-disclosure clause
redFlags.template: If any information in your application is later found incomplete — even unintentionally — the insurer can reject your claim or cancel the policy entirely.

redFlags.name: "Sole discretion" / undefined-term language
redFlags.triggerCondition: raw_text matches discretionary-language patterns (e.g. 'reasonable and customary', 'sole discretion of the Company') AND term is undefined in the policy's definitions section
redFlags.template: This clause lets the insurer decide what counts as a valid or 'reasonable' charge without a defined standard — a common source of claim disputes.

redFlags.name: Sub-limit on ambulance/daycare/pre-post hospitalization
redFlags.template: Ambulance/daycare charges are capped at {value}, separate from your main hospitalization cover.

redFlags.name: Non-network hospital reduced payout
redFlags.template: If you're treated at a hospital outside {insurer}'s network, your payout could be reduced or require full upfront payment and reimbursement instead of cashless.

redFlags.name: Renewal non-guarantee / loading clause
redFlags.template: Making a claim this year could lead to a higher premium or added conditions at renewal — this isn't guaranteed to stay the same.

redFlags.name: Permanent exclusions list
redFlags.template: {condition_or_treatment} is permanently excluded from this policy — it will never be covered, regardless of waiting period.

redFlags.name: Claim intimation deadline
redFlags.template: You must inform the insurer within {timeframe} of hospitalization or risk claim rejection on procedural grounds, even if the treatment itself was valid.

greenFlags.name: No room rent capping
greenFlags.template: There's no cap on your room choice — you can pick any room category without a proportional claim cut.

greenFlags.name: No co-payment
greenFlags.template: You don't pay any percentage of your claims yourself — the full approved amount is covered.

greenFlags.name: Short PED waiting period
greenFlags.template: Pre-existing conditions are covered after just {waiting_period} — shorter than many comparable policies.

greenFlags.name: Restoration/refill benefit
greenFlags.template: If you exhaust your cover, it automatically refills — you're not left uncovered for the rest of the year.

greenFlags.name: No sub-limits on named procedures
greenFlags.template: Major procedures like {examples} are covered up to your full sum insured, with no hidden sub-limit.

greenFlags.name: Cumulative bonus / no-claim bonus
greenFlags.template: Your cover grows automatically for every year you don't claim, at no extra cost.

greenFlags.name: Wide hospital network with cashless
greenFlags.template: You can get cashless treatment at a wide network of hospitals — no need to pay upfront and claim reimbursement later.

rules.absenceOfRedIsNotGreen: Green flags require the explicit favorable clause text to be present. Never infer a green flag purely from the absence of a matching red flag.
rules.multiTrigger: A single extracted clause may trigger multiple flags (e.g. a sub-limited procedure that also has its own waiting period triggers both R02 and R06).
rules.scope: Individual/family floater health insurance only. Do not reuse for motor, term, life, or group/corporate health without a new taxonomy pass.
